## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `./scripts/test.sh` and it passed. I did not skip, weaken or delete any test to get there (`--no-js` is not acceptable when `ChromeExtension/` changed).
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests next to the code it covers.
- [ ] Dependencies: I added, removed or upgraded none, or I updated `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` (version, commit, license text, upstream NOTICE) and any `VENDORING.md` / provenance file.
- [ ] Everything I wrote is in English (the only exception is the Ukrainian root `RUN.md`).
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits with a scope, for example `fix(app): ...`.
- [ ] I did not commit generated or local files (`*.xcodeproj`, `build/`, `dist/`, `.build/`), vault files with real data, or secrets.
- [ ] I did not change `DEVELOPMENT_TEAM`, entitlements or local signing, or I explain why above.
